validation.bulk_comparison_semantics_checks: passed: zero required volume now returns 0 yd3 order / 0 service cost and weight-only bag labels produce notComparable instead of a misleading bags recommendation.
validation.core_non_finite_input_checks: passed: bag required volume/size/price, mix ratios, grow-bag gallons, spacing custom density, and bulk price/minimum/service inputs are sanitized before calculations.

validation.visible_raised_bed_source_controls_check: passed: bags, bulk, mix, cost, and multi modes expose the raised-bed dimensions they depend on instead of using a hidden value from another tab.
validation.task_specific_export_checks: passed: spacing and depth modes now export task-specific copy/CSV/result cards instead of hidden soil-volume commerce data from unrelated raised-bed dimensions.

export_safety_status: fixed: clipboard copy/share actions include a fallback for restricted Clipboard API contexts; CSV downloads use raw numeric cells and CSV escaping; spacing/depth CSV and copied output now reflect the active crop/grid/depth task instead of irrelevant hidden soil-volume commerce data; share URLs preserve all calculator mode-specific state; bulk/cost export values use the current active calculator volume; zero quantity and zero required-volume values remain valid and do not become hidden one-item or minimum-order estimates.
type_hygiene_status: improved: RootLayout imports ReactNode explicitly and slug-page narrowing / lightweight event-result typing remain in place
share_url_status: fixed: Copy share URL now serializes and restores state for mix ratios/templates, container and grow-bag inputs, cost inputs, multi-bed rows, multi-container rows, unit preset, and existing raised/bags/bulk/spacing/shape values; numeric URL values remain non-negative clamped.
zero_quantity_status: fixed: quantity 0 now produces 0 volume in raised bed, shape, top-off, container, grow-bag, multi-bed, and multi-container calculations, with a user-facing zero-volume validation message.
four_by_eight_linking_status: fixed: 4x8 depth output rows include link targets; the 4x8 hub links to 6/8/10/12/18/24 inch pages, and each depth page links back to the hub plus adjacent/relevant depth or bag/bulk pages.
active_volume_status: fixed: result-panel bulk order, savings, CSV bulk cost, shopping-list bulk estimate, project soil cost, and mix breakdown now use activeVolume when displayed outside the mix tab. Multi mode combines raised-bed rows and multi-container rows for focused result and downstream bag/bulk/export calculations. Zero active volume prevents misleading bulk minimum-order recommendations.
bulk_semantics_status: fixed: zero-volume bulk comparisons return no order, no service cost, and a critical warning; weight-only bag labels produce notComparable instead of a false bags-vs-bulk recommendation; non-finite bulk price, delivery, pickup, minimum order, and bag price values are sanitized.
core_function_hardening_status: fixed: calculateSoilBags sanitizes required volume, bag size, and bag price; calculateSoilMix sanitizes non-finite ratios and emits a critical warning; grow-bag gallons and square-foot custom plant density sanitize non-finite values.
mode_scoped_messages_status: fixed: warnings and validation copy are scoped to the active calculator mode; inactive raised-bed, bag, bulk, mix, or cost warnings no longer create unrelated messages in spacing/depth or other workflows.
square_foot_preview_status: fixed: square-foot preview now shows an empty state for zero dimensions and discloses when the visual preview is capped for large grids while calculations still use the full grid dimensions.
unit_consistency_status: fixed: shape depth is isolated from global raised-bed/depth units; freeboard and top-off depth convert with unit preset changes; top-off presets stay equivalent across in/ft/cm/m; 4x8 presets keep unit preset state aligned with ft/in values.
long_tail_layout_status: fixed: 4x8 depth output summaries remain available and internally linked, but now render below the embedded calculator so long-tail pages prioritize the editable tool path.
visible_source_input_status: fixed: modes that depend on raised-bed dimensions now expose editable raised-bed source controls in the active workflow; bags/bulk/mix show them when bed source is selected, cost shows them before cost inputs, and multi shows them as row 1.
task_specific_spacing_depth_status: fixed: spacing and depth modes show task-specific result cards and shopping-list/CSV output; soil-volume bags/bulk/mix panels are reserved for volume modes.
